dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. It's good to speak with you for our arranged discussion. Is this still a convenient time to talk?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Can. Office quite quiet now, so the timing works. Usually someone knocks just when I pick up the phone, but today my staff are handling things outside. Got some breathing space.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'm glad the timing works. We can keep the discussion focused. Have you managed to get away from the office and spend any time in your garden lately?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The gardening still happening lah, just mostly before work. Quite nice to be outside before all the messages start. My plants don't care about my meeting schedule, so cannot keep putting them off.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a welcome change from the office. I'll leave room for any questions you have during our discussion rather than rush through everything.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks. I've got my details here already, no need to go searching through my bag. My FIN is G one four nine six five three two I. My date of birth is 22 April 1956.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Let me cover the relevant points before we move on. To confirm, your investment objective is long-term capital growth through broadly diversified global equity exposure. With Summit Global Equity ETF, diversification does not prevent a fall in value if global equity markets decline broadly. Do you understand that the fund's value can fall during a broad global equity downturn despite its diversification?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. Spread across different companies also can fall if the global market drops. For this transaction, I'll go with Summit Global Equity ETF. Keep the explanation straightforward like this lah; technical language takes me longer to follow.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Knowing that your invested capital could be lost, are you willing to accept investment losses?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses, including losing the capital I put in.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend Summit Global Equity ETF because its diversified global equity exposure supports your long-term capital-growth objective and reduces reliance on any individual company's performance.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Before I commit, can you guarantee the returns or not?

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: No, I cannot guarantee future returns. The investment's performance is uncertain.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm, let me think for a moment ah. No need to fill the silence; sometimes I just need a quiet pause.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Of course. Take your time; I'm here when you're ready to continue.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Right, got my notes in front of me. I want to buy, ah. Use Japanese yen for the transaction, please. The amount I'm committing is 5m. Quantity, make it 1,500 units. Put it through as a limit order, with the limit price at 3,333 Japanese yen.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your final instruction is to buy 1,500 units of Summit Global Equity ETF, with a transaction amount of 5m in Japanese yen, using a limit order at a limit price of 3,333 Japanese yen. Do you confirm this instruction?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please place the order as you've just stated.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Before we finish, for arranging future conversations, would you prefer a message in advance rather than an unexpected call during your working day?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Message first would be better. Sometimes got customers sitting opposite me, then answering the phone quite awkward. If I can step away beforehand, less troublesome for everyone lor.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note that preference for arranging future discussions. You can let me know a convenient time when you reply, and we can coordinate from there.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That arrangement easier lah. Anyway, better get back to the office work now. The garden can wait until I get home; still got some pots to tidy.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian Lim. I hope the rest of your working day goes smoothly. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel Tan. Nice to talk without interruptions for a change ah. Bye.
